goal: Tell how Shelfie started, show the market and the cost of shelf checks today, introduce the team, and send visitors to /dashboard (order a check) or /w (take checks)
chosenVariant: transformation: the shopping cart from the logo assembles while the story is told

style.tone: warm, concrete, editorial; numbers always with a source
style.type: large condensed display headlines, system fonts (CSP allows no web fonts)

rooms.title: The cart assembles
rooms.renderer: canvasSequence (procedural: progress -> frame drawn in code, no image files)

beats.headline: Paid only when the photo is true.
beats.visual: ghost outline of the cart; the handle draws itself

beats.headline: Can you photograph my competitors in a few shops?
beats.visual: basket outline, then the basket grid

beats.headline: He can't check our photos. An AI can't see a shelf.
An agent that hires a person to look.
beats.visual: back wheels: all four wheels on the ground

beats.headline: A verifier checks every photo before anyone is paid.
beats.visual: products fall into the basket; photo card with a price tag and a hand gesture gets a green check

beats.headline: Nobody pays for a photo that isn't true.
beats.visual: cart rolls with speed lines; two escrow blocks joined by a chain (logo)

rooms.content: three sourced market figures with count-up
cost bars (upper value of each published range) and the 10-store comparison
five steps: order, claim, photograph, verify, settle
four people with photo, study program and role

assets.source: team logo, palette swatches cropped off
photos supplied by the team, 480 px

qaChecks: Mobile 390x844 at the same progress points
No blank canvas (ghost outline from progress 0)
No text overlap between beats and the cart
Reduced motion and no-JS fallbacks show every beat as plain content
No inline script or style (site CSP)
